Strategies for this week's brawl? [The Masked Ball]

My initial thoughts on strategy (after a half hour)

  • People are realizing that silence/hex/etc are powerful for large minions. Don't count on your KT or Rag getting to stick around.

  • With the minions being sticky, Savage Roar and Bloodlust strategies seem quite powerful. Lots of bodies make Druid and Shaman very dangerous when they have a board

  • Minions relying on either battlecry or on spawning other minions are better in this brawl. Not sure if this will hold up as a solid strategy, but I've seen plenty of Silver Hand Knights and Dragonling Mechanics.

  • All hail the mighty Sea Giant! This thing absolutely rocks in this brawl

  • Single-target removal seems less effective since there are extra enemy minions to be removed. Right now it seems like zoo-like strategies of controlling the board via minions is the best call.

  • Mind Control Tech is your friend. Play him
